c.tagline: A harbor town beneath rock-cut Lycian tombs, gateway to the Blue Lagoon and the Turquoise Coast's best paragliding

card: Widely accepted at hotels, restaurants, and marina shops; small local eateries and beach vendors may prefer cash.
rides: dolmuş minibuses to Ölüdeniz and Çalış

taxi.fare: Roughly ₺30-50 flag fall plus metered per-km rate
taxi.fareNote: Metered fares are standard in town; agree a flat rate for longer trips to Ölüdeniz or Saklıkent

english.label: Easy to get by in English

walk: Central Fethiye's marina and old town lanes are walkable, but Ölüdeniz, Kayaköy, and Saklıkent are outside town and require a dolmuş, taxi, or tour.

safety.safety: Very safe for solo travelers, including women; Fethiye is a well-established resort town popular with independent travelers
safety.crime: Petty theft is rare; the main practical caution is paragliding/adventure-sport safety rather than crime

hood_landmark.Fethiye Marina / Old Town: Fethiye Marina and the Lycian rock tombs above town
hood_landmark.Ölüdeniz: Ölüdeniz Blue Lagoon and Babadağ paragliding launch

avoid.reason: Harbor-front boat-tour touts and inflated taxi fares; keep usual awareness in the Tuesday market crowds.

hood_desc: The commercial and historic core, with the yacht marina, Tuesday market, and Lycian rock tombs carved into the cliffs above town.
A long sandy beach suburb a short dolmuş ride from central Fethiye, popular for sunset views over the bay.
The postcard Blue Lagoon beach and paragliding hub a short drive south, Turkey's most photographed stretch of coast.
A hauntingly preserved abandoned Greek village in the hills above Ölüdeniz, evacuated in the 1923 population exchange.
A hillside resort village above Ölüdeniz known for its lively bar strip and package-holiday nightlife.

water.note: Drink bottled water; tap is chlorinated but locals and visitors alike buy bottled.

transit.sys: Dolmuş (shared minibus) network connecting Fethiye to Ölüdeniz, Çalış, and outlying villages
transit.map: Dolmuş depart from the main Fethiye otogar near the marina
transit.note: Boat trips (the '12 Islands Tour') are a popular way to see the coast from Fethiye's harbor

transport.air: Dalaman Airport (DLM), about 50 km away, has direct flights from Istanbul and seasonal international routes from across Europe
transport.bus: Overnight coaches connect Fethiye to Istanbul, Izmir, and other Turkish cities via the otogar
transport.ferry: Seasonal boat tours connect Fethiye to nearby coastal towns; no scheduled international ferry
transport.car: Self-driving is popular for exploring Kayaköy, Saklıkent, and the coastal villages independently

airport.name: Dalaman Airport
airport.transport: Havaş shuttle buses and pre-booked hotel transfers; taxi transfer roughly $40-55

net.m: Good 4G/5G coverage in Fethiye and along the coast
net.w: Free wifi standard in hotels and cafes
net.fwn: Free wifi widely available in hotels and marina cafes
net.ap: A Turkcell or Vodafone tourist SIM or eSIM is recommended

tip.s: 10% is customary for tour guides, paragliding instructors, and boat crews
tip.r: 10% is standard at restaurants where service isn't already included
